## Type of feedback
Earlier work / mathematical correction / software bug / explanation

## The specific claim or behavior
Link to the section, file, or statement.

## Evidence
Give the relevant theorem or citation, counterexample, or reproduction steps. For calculator issues, include the block count and per-sensor failure probability.

## Suggested correction
If known. Distinguish an incorrect result from one that is correct but already known.
